We build approved prompts and templates around HMCI’s sources, audiences and voice. Then we teach employees and partners how to use them through hands-on AI design sessions using their own work. First we review the materials HMCI and its partners already use. Then we build the brand guide and prompt library. The monthly creative retainer keeps the work moving, with a short report on delivery and next priorities. The first conversation defines the starting scope.
